title: fastapi: Bug report (discussion #14489) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is fastapi (an open-source Python library). Bug report (discussion #14489) from a user of this library:

> With `FastAPI(separate_input_output_schemas=False)`, a model with a `@computed_field` that is used for both the request body and the response gets separate `-Input` and `-Output` schemas, which is right. But when that model is only *nested* in the response model (as a field, in a list, or recursively), the OpenAPI schema is wrong: the response refers to the `-Input` schema, which lacks the computed field, instead of the `-Output` one. Any model with a computed field anywhere in its nested models should get separate input and output schemas, and responses should reference the `-Output` ones (with the computed field marked `readOnly`).

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
